title: Master card: sidechain and ducking
comments: Source: SC BUS button picks BUS (SC_SUM) or INT (COMP L+R)/2; a plug in SC EXT overrides (ring switch)
Sallen-Key LPF 44-478 Hz (RV501; LPF button: pressed = in); SC_DET feeds the compressor, the ducker and SC LISTEN (cue)
Ducker: window comparator on THRESHOLD (0.26-1.8 V), charges 2u2 to DEPTH (0 to -4 V, -1 V = 10 dB) in about 3 ms, DECAY 48 ms-1.15 s
Decisions 90, 104, 199 (THRESHOLD range, LPF button, ducking LED); simulated in simulation/sidechain/run.py
